prompt: Implement the attached organization-wide Docker base image management brief; support Debian 11 bullseye, Debian 12 bookworm, Debian 13 trixie, Ubuntu 20.04 through 26.04 major LTS releases, opinionated framework images, GitHub Actions publishing, the latest four Alpine and BusyBox versions, a dropdown image selector, and automatic date/time tags.
response: Added Debian, Ubuntu, React, Vite, Alpine 3.21-3.24, and BusyBox 1.36.0-1.38.0 catalog entries plus Dockerfiles, lifecycle metadata, support-matrix entries, and exactly three user-facing GHCR workflows: Publish base image, Publish runtime image, and Publish framework image. Documented services as ready-to-run infrastructure such as web servers, databases, brokers, proxies, and observability components; the current Nginx service is handled by the base workflow until the service catalog grows. Runtimes require a digest-pinned Debian 13 OS image, verify that OS digest exists in GHCR, and build final images FROM the approved OS while copying the pinned runtime payload. All workflows publish immutable timestamped and moving version tags. BusyBox 1.38.0 is experimental because upstream identifies it as unstable. Verified upstream digests remain release gates.
